review_candidates.title: Project Risk Manager
review_candidates.description: Job Description Costain have won extensive work across the water sector to support the AMP 8 investment cycle. We have been appointed by Northumbrian Water to the Living Water Enterprise to help shape and deliver its strategic infrastructure upgrade programme with contracts valued up to c.£670m to Costain over 15 years. Reporting into the Head of Planning / PMO, the Risk Manager will be fully integrated and embedded into the framework with a remit to ensure that the project teams meet their risk and opportunity management challenges through improved risk practice and awareness. You’ll be responsible for management of the implementation and ongoing assurance of governance and any contract specific requirements. As a commercially astute Risk Manager you’ll work in collaboration with stakeholders at scheme and framework level and you’ll identify, analyse and develop responses to project risks & opportunities, taking ownership and responsibility. You’ll play an important role in developing a positive risk and opportunity culture within the framework. By embedding and championing best-practice risk and opportunity management tools and techniques across the allocated programmes you’ll enable a timely, efficient, safe and customer-focused delivery. Responsibilities Ensure risk mitigation measures are progressed in response to EWN’s Draft and update the contract Risk Management Plan’s Manage risk and continuously develop the risk and opportunity register into a management tool containing accurate and relevant information for reporting purposes Risk identification, qualitative and quantitative analysis, contractual allocation and preparing action plans; Manage the Risk and Opportunity Register Carry out risk and opportunity workshops as and when required; Risk and opportunity reporting, ensuring information is consistently accurate and relevant; Develop, implement and oversee effective and credible risk response and risk mitigation plans Ensure that the senior management team, are sufficiently sighted on and familiar with the project risk and opportunity position Act as a conduit for the escalation of risk or failure to obtain opportunities in line with established processes Be prepared to challenge risk and opportunity owners and other individuals on their response to risk and securing opportunities Contribute to the continual improvement in risk processes and the continual development of a risk mature culture across the project Produce risk and opportunity reports and dashboards in line with project requirements Qualifications Skilled and experienced in NEC project and programme management and risk management methodologies Skilled and experienced in the use of risk and opportunity management systems and tools Strong verbal, written and presentational skills with a high level of analytical and numerate skills Self-motivated with good interpersonal skills working in a team environment Good attention to detail Excellent communication and presentational skills Able to use initiative About Us Costain helps to improve people’s lives with integrated, leading edge, smart infrastructure solutions across the UK’s energy, water, transportation and defence markets. We help our clients improve their business performance by increasing capacity, improving customer service, safeguarding security, enhancing resilience, decarbonising and delivering increased efficiency. Our vision is to be the UK’s leading smart infrastructure solutions company. We will achieve this by focusing on blue chip clients whose major spending plans are underpinned by strategic national needs, regulatory commitments, legislation or essential performance requirements. We offer our clients leading edge solutions that are digitally optimised through the following five services which cover the whole lifecycle of their assets: future-shaping strategic consultancy; consultancy and advisory; digital technology solutions; asset optimisation and complex programme delivery. Our culture and values underpin everything we do. Costain appreciate the time and effort taken when applying for one of our positions but, due to the high volume of responses, we are unable to provide individual feedback on candidates at application phase. We do share individual feedback following an interview . A Disability Confident employer will generally offer an interview to any applicant that disclose they have a disability and meets the minimum criteria for the job as defined by the employer. It is important to note that in certain recruitment situations such as high-volume, seasonal and high-peak times, the employer may wish to limit the overall numbers of interviews offered to both disabled people and non-disabled people. review_candidates.title: Project Manager - Energy & Power UK
review_candidates.description: At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good. Your impact Bring your expertise to projects that will shape the UK's energy future. Jacobs is growing its Project Management team in South and South West to support a significant energy infrastructure programme expected to commence before the end of the year. This is an opportunity to play a key role from the outset, helping to shape delivery strategy, influence important decisions, and contribute to successful project outcomes across the full lifecycle. We're looking for experienced Project Managers who can bring project delivery expertise, commercial awareness, and a collaborative approach to complex infrastructure programmes. While experience within the energy sector would be valuable, we welcome applications from professionals delivering projects across infrastructure, transportation, water, defence, utilities, and industrial environments. Experience within a Design & Build environment would be particularly advantageous, bringing an understanding of how design, procurement, construction, and stakeholder management come together to achieve successful project delivery. At Jacobs, we're helping clients decarbonise, strengthen energy security, and modernise critical infrastructure. From grid connections for offshore wind and battery storage projects to major transmission upgrades, hydrogen developments, nuclear programmes, and complex refurbishment schemes, we're delivering projects that support the UK's energy transition. This opportunity offers you the chance to Join a major programme during its early stages and help shape its future direction Work alongside multidisciplinary teams across design, commercial, environmental, and construction functions Contribute to nationally significant infrastructure projects with long-term investment and visibility Develop your career within one of the world's leading engineering and professional services consultancies Support projects that make a meaningful contribution to the UK's net-zero ambitions What you'll be doing Supporting the delivery of complex projects and programmes throughout the full project lifecycle Managing scope, schedule, cost, quality, and risk to achieve successful outcomes Building effective relationships with clients, stakeholders, and supply chain partners Driving project governance, reporting, and commercial management activities Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to deliver projects safely, efficiently, and successfully Coordinating multidisciplinary teams across engineering, construction, and environmental disciplines Supporting safe, efficient, and successful project delivery from concept through to handover Office base can be London/ Bristol or Cardiff - hybrid 2 days in the office. Here's what you'll need Proven experience delivering energy, power, utilities, or major infrastructure projects Design and Build Delivery experience Strong understanding and proven management of the project lifecycle (design → procurement → construction → commissioning → handover) Solid skills in project controls scope, schedule, cost, risk, reporting Experience managing stakeholders (clients, designers, contractors, regulators) Ability to lead and coordinate multi‑disciplinary teams Relevant degree or equivalent experience (Engineering, PM, Construction) At Jacobs, you'll find more than just a job. You'll discover A global network of expertise and opportunity A culture founded on safety, integrity, inclusion, and belonging Flexible working arrangements that support your well-being and potential Opportunities to make a real-world impact through our global giving and volunteering programs Up to 10% pension 24 days (+10 days bought) holidays Free medical and income protection insurance and many more! If you're looking for an opportunity to contribute to one of Scotland's most significant upcoming energy programmes and help shape the future of critical infrastructure, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now! Joining Jacobs not only connects you locally but globally. Our values stand on a foundation of safety, integrity, inclusion and belonging. We put people at the heart of our business, and we truly believe that by supporting one another through our culture of caring, we all succeed. We value positive mental health and a sense of belonging for all employees. With safety and flexibility always top of mind, we’ve gone beyond traditional ways of working so you have the support, means and space to maximize your potential. You’ll uncover flexible working arrangements, benefits, and opportunities, from well-being benefits to our global giving and volunteering program, to exploring new and inventive ways to help our clients make the world a better place. No matter what drives you, you’ll discover how you can cultivate, nurture, and achieve your goals – all at a single global company. Find out more about life at Jacobs. We aim to embed inclusion and belonging in everything we do. We know that if we are inclusive, we’re more connected and creative. We accept people for who they are, and we champion the richness of different perspectives, lived experiences and backgrounds in the workplace, as a source of learning and innovation. We are committed to building vibrant communities within Jacobs, including through our Jacobs Employee Networks, Communities of Practice and our Find Your Community initiatives, allowing every employee to find connection, purpose, and belonging. Find out more about our Jacobs Employee Networks here. Jacobs partners with VERCIDA to help us attract and retain talent from a wide range of backgrounds. For greater online accessibility please visit https//www.vercida.com/uk/employers/jacobs to view and access our roles. As a disability confident employer, we will interview disabled candidates who best meet the criteria. We welcome applications from candidates who are seeking flexible working and from those who may not meet all the listed requirements for a role. We value collaboration and believe that in-person interactions are crucial for both our culture and client delivery. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work. Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

review_candidates.description: In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next! In this role, you will develop, manage, and execute all phases of the project controls effort for a major iconic metro station project, including planning, scheduling, cost analysis, reporting, forecasting, and performance monitoring. Position Overview: Develops, manages, and/or executes all phases of the project controls effort for a major iconic metro station project, including planning, scheduling, cost analysis, progress measurement, forecasting, reporting, and change control. The incumbent utilizes widely diversified knowledge of project controls activities and draws upon extensive experience and exposure to major transportation infrastructure, metro, rail, station, and complex building projects. The role supports the successful delivery of the project by monitoring performance against schedule, budget, milestones, and contractual requirements. What You’ll Be Doing Develop, manage, and execute all phases of the project controls effort, including planning, scheduling, cost analysis, progress measurement, forecasting, reporting, and change control. Provide guidance, direction, and specialized assistance to the project for the resolution of difficult and complex project control problems. Interface with clients, attend regular meetings, and provide statistical, progress, cost, schedule, and performance reports. Manage a team of Project Control Engineers/Specialists responsible for analyzing, evaluating, and forecasting project costs and schedule performance. Oversee the development and maintenance of the project baseline schedule, including critical milestones, interfaces, testing, commissioning, and handover requirements. Assess the impact of design changes, construction changes, interface issues, delays, and schedule slippages. Oversee the development and maintenance of project controls systems, reports, dashboards, and performance analysis. Coordinate project controls requirements across civil, structural, architectural, MEP, systems, finishes, public realm, testing, commissioning, and handover activities. Coordinate staffing requirements, assign and supervise project controls work activities, and train personnel. Complete performance reviews and provide personnel development for assigned employees. Support change management by providing schedule and cost impact analysis for variations, claims, delays, and potential change orders. Keep project and company management fully informed of project controls status, issues, trends, and risks. Participate in business development efforts by gathering and presenting a variety of background data, as required. Perform other responsibilities associated with this position as may be appropriate. What Required Skills You’ll Bring Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or Construction Management or related field, or equivalent work experience. Minimum 12 years of related experience. Experience in a supervisory capacity. Experience in project controls on major transportation infrastructure, metro, rail, transit station, or complex building projects. Requires basic engineering knowledge in electrical, mechanical, civil, or a related field. Proficient PC skills, including proficiency in various Project Controls Software and Microsoft Office Suite. Strong knowledge of planning, scheduling, cost control, progress measurement, forecasting, reporting, change control, and performance analysis. Proven ability to perform in a supervisory capacity. Thorough knowledge of industry practices. Strong analytical, communication, coordination, and reporting skills. Ability to meet Parsons Project Controls Manager Certification requirements. What Desired Skills You’ll Bring Experience on iconic metro station, rail, transit, or major transportation infrastructure projects is preferred. Experience supporting civil, structural, architectural, MEP, systems, finishes, public realm, testing, commissioning, and handover activities. Experience with Primavera P6 or equivalent planning and scheduling software. Experience with project controls dashboards, reporting systems, PMIS platforms, and digital delivery tools. Strong understanding of schedule and cost impact analysis for changes, claims, delays, and interface issues. Experience working with clients, consultants, suppliers, subcontractors, government agencies, and regulatory authorities. Regional experience in Saudi Arabia or the Middle East would be an advantage. Parsons equally employs representation at all job levels no matter the race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability or genetic information. We truly invest and care about our employee’s wellbeing and provide endless growth opportunities as the sky is the limit, so aim for the stars! Imagine next and join the Parsons quest—APPLY TODAY! Transforming Waste into Value At Kanadevia Inova, we pride ourselves on being at the forefront of waste-to-X technology. We are not just waste managers; we are creators of value from what communities discard. Your role at Kanadevia Inova directly contributes to turning something once considered useless - waste - into something invaluable: energy, heat, hydrogen, fertilizer, and beyond. Job Description Lead the civil engineering scope for Waste-to-X projects within a civil consortium or EPC civil works package. Coordinate civil design interfaces with consortium partners, subcontractors, internal engineering teams, clients, and authorities. Manage design activities during procurement and execution phases for civil, structural, geotechnical, architectural, and infrastructure packages. Ensure smooth collaboration between civil engineering disciplines and project stakeholders throughout design and construction. Support preparation of civil procurement packages, including technical and commercial contract requirements. Assist in contractor negotiations and respond to technical queries during procurement and project execution. Report project progress to project management and operations teams while supporting claim management activities. Travel up to 10% as required for project coordination and execution. Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil or Structural Engineering. Minimum 5+ years of experience in EPC, construction, or large industrial projects as a Design Engineer. Proven experience delivering projects in Hungary and/or the Central and Eastern European (CEE) region, with a strong understanding of local regulations, permitting processes, and industry standards. Established professional network and local market knowledge in Hungary are highly desirable. Proven project management capabilities; PM certifications are an advantage. Strong knowledge of international civil engineering design and construction codes and standards. Experience with structural design software and 3D BIM tools such as Autodesk Revit and Navisworks. Excellent communication, coordination, and negotiation skills. Assertive and decisive personality with experience working in remote and multicultural teams. Fluent in Hungarian and English, both written and spoken. Additional European languages are an advantage. Additional Information We offer Responsible challenge with diversified field of activity Team-oriented working atmosphere in an international Company Personal development opportunities through own Inova Academy Opportunity to gain an insight into various technical disciplines Excellent employment conditions Attractive working place (central, good transport links) Modern infrastructure For HR agencies: Please note that we do not accept applications coming from agencies. Thank you.

review_candidates.title: Freight Network Design Engineer
review_candidates.description: Hungry for challenges? Join a group with innovation at its heart and contribute to the automotive revolution! With 38,900 team members located in 28 countries and a 2024 revenue of €11.6 billion, Opmobility is world leader in intelligent exterior systems, clean energy systems and front-end modules. Through its offer in the exterior body panels market, Opmobility provides customized multi-material solutions with high added value that increasingly integrate functions and enhance safety to reduce vehicle weight and CO2 emissions. Our ambition? Provide automakers with cutting-edge equipment and solutions to develop tomorrow’s clean and connected car. As a responsible company, Opmobility pays particular attention to diversity and equality within its teams and the Group commits to treat all job applications equally. The mission: The process of analyzing large shares of the transportation network in terms of cost and performance, identifying improvement potential, making large scale change decisions and implementing a new transportation network structure. This may for example include implementation of new hubs or decisions to make major changes to carrier structure. The scope would be extended to other PO divisions. As a Freight Network Design Engineer, you will be responsible for: Calculate & Design Optimized Transport Routes primarily focusing on our Bill of Materials (BOM) suppliers. Strive to reduce costs and CO² footprint and enhance efficiency in our logistics operations. Support freight cost savings initiatives (by plant, by region) with cross-plant synergies. Collaborate with internal stakeholders to support freight cost savings initiatives, both at the plant and regional levels. Identify and leverage cross-plant synergies within the division, while also considering cross-divisional opportunities. Support the new routes implementation in coordination with the plant supply chain teams, the purchasing and the forwarders to ensure the successful implementation of new transportation routes. Manage the transition smoothly and effectively. Monitor regularly the performance of transportation routes through key performance indicators (KPIs e.g. cost, truck utilization etc.) and evaluate their continued suitability in light of changing demand patterns. Revise the network design when necessary to align with evolving requirements. Identify and highlight data inconsistencies and collaborate with plant teams to implement corrective actions. Drive a culture of continuous improvement in network design and performance. Provide analytical data and support the team to execute tenders. Prepares a calculation base for budget, regularly updates forecast based on the actual costs, investigates deviations to original plan. Provides regular updates on the data to be maintained in transport database, ERP and legal documentation. Education background: A Bachelor or Master Degree in Supply Chain, Logistics or equivalent. Experience: 5 to 8 years working experience in the position of network design in automotive, forwarding, logistics or distribution industry Experience in reporting and managing projects with cross-functional and global stakeholders You are: Team player, you have good communication skills A strong desire to be innovative and be creative Data & Process orientated Strong Customer orientation

review_candidates.title: Engenheira de Planejamento Sênior - Vaga exclusiva para mulheres
review_candidates.location: Conceição do Mato Dentro, Minas Gerais, Brazil
review_candidates.description: Descrição da empresa A Anglo American é uma empresa global de mineração com sede em Londres, presente em diversos países e com uma história de mais de 100 anos, com o propósito de reimaginar a mineração para melhorar a vida das pessoas. Na América Latina, nossas operações desempenham um papel estratégico no fornecimento responsável de recursos essenciais para o desenvolvimento do mundo – com atuação no Brasil, Chile e Peru, sempre pautadas por inovação, segurança, sustentabilidade e alto desempenho. No Brasil, operamos o sistema Minas-Rio, que integra mina, usina, mineroduto e porto. As operações do Peru e do Chile se concentram na produção de cobre em larga escala, reforçando nosso compromisso com uma transição energética sustentável. Acreditamos que nossas pessoas são o maior diferencial competitivo. Investimos no desenvolvimento de talentos, promovendo ambientes inclusivos e colaborativos, onde diferentes perspectivas constroem soluções melhores para os desafios do presente e do futuro. Na Anglo American, valorizamos quem deseja crescer com propósito e gerar impacto real. Descrição da vaga Como Engenheira de Planejamento Sênior , você será responsável por liderar o planejamento, monitoramento e controle de projetos e obras de infraestrutura de pequeno, médio e grande porte, garantindo a integração das informações relacionadas a engenharia, suprimentos, contratos, cronogramas e controle de custos. Atuará na elaboração de cronogramas executivos, avaliação de prioridades de demandas, análises de desempenho, gestão de riscos e definição de estratégias para assegurar o atendimento aos requisitos de prazo, custo, qualidade e segurança. Veja abaixo as principais atividades: Elaborar, consolidar e controlar cronogramas de implantação de projetos e obras de infraestrutura utilizando, MS Project e demais ferramentas de planejamento. Desenvolver Estruturas Analíticas de Projeto, planos de execução, curvas de avanço físico e financeiro e cronogramas integrados. Realizar análises de caminho crítico, produtividade, riscos e restrições, propondo ações de mitigação. Monitorar e reportar o avanço financeiro do orçamento da gerência, identificando desvios e oportunidades de melhoria no desempenho dos processos. Conduzir o planejamento de curto, médio e longo prazo, integrando engenharia, suprimentos, contratos e construção. Elaborar relatórios gerenciais, dashboards e indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) para suporte à tomada de decisão da gerência e diretoria. Apoiar a definição estratégica de priorização de demandas, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e otimização nos processos de serviços, facilities e gestão operacional, contribuindo para o aumento da eficiência, produtividade e qualidade das entregas. Apoiar estratégias de contratação, mobilização de recursos e dimensionamento de equipes e equipamentos.
